evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: This requests one feature (search/discover music) with alternative methods; methods are attributes of the same feature, not separate implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Single feature (search/discover by profile); the profile is a search parameter, not a separate feature.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: One feature (recommendation/search based on similar users); it describes a single retrieval criterion.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single feature (search/discover by content similarity); it enumerates target items but not independent features.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path
evaluations.rationale: Single search/discovery feature with listed outcomes and metadata sources; enumerated results are attributes, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: This expresses one requirement about tagged-video upload where tags must be available downstream; the parts are part of the same feature flow.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature (view thumbnail sequences).

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature (retrieve information about similar items/segments); similarity context and item types are attributes.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single information-retrieval feature specifying perceptual similarity as the criterion.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Single recommendation feature based on similar profiles.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: One recommendation feature using news-events-as-input; not multiple independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Identification plus showing related info is a single entity-recognition feature with expected output; the parts form one cohesive feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Single object-recognition feature where identification and providing related info are part of the same capability.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Single recognition feature with related information as part of the expected output.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Single recognition-and-info feature; not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: One feature (provide recommendations from an image input); 'take or upload' are alternate input methods, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest
evaluations.rationale: Single location-based discovery feature (map access + notifications about coverage); map and notifications are aspects of same feature.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Single search feature using ASR as input modality.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: This bundles multiple independently implementable operations (viewing, validating, editing segmentation) in one story.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotating and separately extracting topics are distinct features (manual annotation vs automated topic extraction) and can be prioritized/implemented separately.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering and ranking are separate operations (selection vs ordering) that can be implemented and tested independently.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Single detection/assessment feature.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Single prefiltering feature focused on nudity detection.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: One prefiltering feature that uses low-level asset info as criteria; not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Single automated validation feature (copyright infringement detection).

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: Single prefiltering/search feature with listed sources of metadata; these are attributes of the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: One assessment feature that lists inputs and possible assessment dimensions; enumerated dimensions are attributes of the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Single detection/alerting feature using specified inputs.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Single classification/identification feature.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Single automated preclassification feature with a specified method.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Single image-series-detection feature for a specific failure mode.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single species preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single attribute preclassification feature (e.g., behavior/pose); attributes are part of one feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single counting/detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: 'Segmentation or localization' offers alternative approaches to the same objective; they are variants/attributes of one feature, not two independent features.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size and orientation are attributes to detect within one feature; they are not independent features.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single species preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Single motion-analysis feature with the goal of reducing video duration.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Single temporal-detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: One feature (detect important features) that lists multiple target types; enumerated target types are attributes of the same detection capability.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Single assessment/weighting feature using volunteer experience as input.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Single prefiltering feature describing artefacts to remove; these are examples not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature identifying moving/transient objects; the two descriptors refer to related kinds of objects, not independent features.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Single audio-cleaning feature; both 'background noise' and 'distracting sounds' are aspects of the same processing capability.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Single clustering/grouping feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Single counting/detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single decision/notification feature (timing of interruption).

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single decision feature about choosing interruption medium; it refines the interruption decision rather than introducing an independent feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single decision/notification feature (timing of education).

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single decision feature about education medium; refines when/what form education should take, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single recommendation/selection feature (choose education content).

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single detection/flagging feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single decision/triggering feature for Zoonibot commenting.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Single decision/triggering feature for explanatory responses from Zoonibot.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single content-generation/specification feature for Zoonibot messages.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single clustering/grouping feature.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Single recommendation feature (project recommendations using experience as input).

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Single summarization/preview feature enabling reuse.
